hero.intro: Hey, I’m **Raj Roy**, a.k.a. **KiNG** online. I build full-stack web apps (MERN), mobile apps (React Native & Android) and applied ML projects, and I travel solo with a camera. Most of my ideas start somewhere on the road. Hop in, I’ll be your guide.

ticker: SafarNama won the Special Jury Award
TripWise: AI trip planner in progress

about.lead: Most of my projects start with a problem I ran into ==on the road==.
paragraphs: I’m from **Northeast India** and grew up in **Arunachal Pradesh**, surrounded by hills, rivers and a lot of quiet. That’s where two habits started: wanting to see what’s past the next ridge, and wanting to know how things actually work.

I did my **BCA at Assam Don Bosco University** and moved to Chennai for my **MCA at SRM Institute of Science and Technology** (2025–27). Somewhere in between I noticed my two favourite things weren’t separate at all.

I travel solo a lot, and on the road I keep running into small problems: scattered info, no easy way to meet other travellers, nothing nudging people to travel responsibly. Those problems turn into my projects. **SafarNama**, built with my team, started exactly like that, and **Wanderlens** and **TripWise** are where it’s heading now.
These days I’m building my MCA capstone, practising DSA every day and getting ready for placements. I’m still learning, and I like it that way.
